_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Seeds the NHL schedule-window cache (key nhl_schedule_window_14_7: _schedule_window()'s suffix for the default 14-day lookback and 7-day lookahead) with one final, one in-progress, and one scheduled game so recent/upcoming render real game cards without network access. test_mode makes the always-instantiated live manager simulate its game instead of fetching today's scoreboard (NHLLiveManager._fetch_data() -> _fetch_todays_games() is a direct network call with no cache read). A huge update_intervals.live used to stand in for it, but with no live games the live manager polls on its idle back-off, not that interval, so it fetched on every render. update() must stay cache-only: freezegun hands the real clock to calls made from a thread's run(), so the SwitchRefresh thread display() starts always finds its manager due and runs update(), and a fetch still in flight when freeze_time ends reads the real date. Live display stays off so the screens under test and their goldens are unchanged.
